brief:
Israeli colonizers killed a Palestinian young man and injured two others during an incident Sunday night in Hajja village, east of Qalqilia in the northwestern West Bank, IMEMC News reported. One of the wounded sustained critical injuries, according to the Palestinian Red Crescent Society. The village lies in an area where illegal Israeli settlements have established a presence in occupied Palestinian territory.

The killing marked another deadly confrontation in a region where tensions between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers remain high. The circumstances surrounding the incident were not immediately detailed in initial reports.
